verdict.rationale: Jira ships an in-app AI assistant (Rovo AI), so this axis applies. The evidence only documents Rovo creating automations, breaking down tasks, auto-assigning work, and surfacing trends. Nothing shows it learning a user's tone, shorthand, or preferences to tailor its output.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have my in-app AI assistant learn my tone, shorthand, and preferences to tailor its output
